answer_2.quote: We use the BLEUs and METEOR to measure the match scores between generated responses and ground-truth references. ... We also use the classification accuracy ... for each attribute computed by an independently trained Roberta classifier ... we calculate the cosine similarity ... i.e., P-SIM ... via a Roberta-based Natural Language Inference (NLI) model, i.e., P-NLI ... we propose a unified model-based evaluation metric, i.e. MAE

answer_3.quote: we propose a unified model-based evaluation metric, i.e. Multiple Attribute Evaluation (MAE) ... the evaluation of each attribute is converted to a text-to-text generation task based on T5 ... and the generated probability of 'yes' is regarded as the controllability score
methods: text-to-text generation with handcrafted templates and continuous prompts

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 100 examples from two datasets and collect the corresponding generated responses ... 5 human annotators are invited to evaluate ... For the text quality, we ask the annotators to evaluate the fluency and context relevancy
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated controllability on a scale of 1-3 and text quality (fluency and context relevancy) on a scale of 1-5.
